description: pixel art, the lower half of a woman prophetess in a flowing white and gold robe with golden sun and star embroidery and a long golden stole, with long golden hair down her back, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the hips sit on the saddle, the robe falls over the near thigh which lies forward along the horse's back, from the knee the robe hangs straight down and one golden sandal shows below its hem, resting level in a stirrup that is not drawn; her long golden hair ends above the saddle; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, transparent background
